Use the peak evidence and structural compatibility; theoretical and experimental Raman spectra may differ.
Do not invent, modify, or combine candidates. Even when uncertain, choose the best available candidate.

## Retrieved spectroscopic knowledge

Rules may mention IR and Raman bands: an IR-only band is not direct Raman evidence. Check the stated activity, molecular system and phase before using a rule. Missing or overlapping bands do not by themselves exclude a candidate.

## Full Rule Details (for reference)

- **ENV-001** [DEFINITIVE] Hydrogen bonding: lowers X-H stretching frequency (broadens band), raises X-H bending frequency [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **FRQ-001** [DEFINITIVE] Bond order-frequency correlation: Higher bond order → higher vibrational frequency [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-001** [DEFINITIVE] O-H stretching: free OH ~3600-3700 cm⁻¹; H-bonded OH ~3400-3200 cm⁻¹ (broad); O-H bending ~1600-1650 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-002** [DEFINITIVE] N-H stretching: ~3300-3400 cm⁻¹ (NH₃ gas: ν₁ 3414, ν₃ 3336 cm⁻¹); N-H bending: ~1600-1650 cm⁻¹ (ν₂), ~930-970 cm⁻¹ (ν₄) [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-005** [DEFINITIVE] S-H stretching: ~2550-2620 cm⁻¹; S-H bending: ~1180 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-018** [DEFINITIVE] O₂ molecule: ν(O-O) decreases with increasing negative charge: O₂⁺ (1876) > O₂ (1580) > O₂⁻ (1094) > O₂²⁻ (791/736 cm⁻¹) [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-021** [DEFINITIVE] ν(N≡N) of N₂O: ν₁(N≡N stretch) ~2277, ν₂(bend) ~597, ν₃(N=O stretch) ~1300 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-022** [DEFINITIVE] ν(NO₂) for nitro/nitrite groups: NO₂⁻ (nitrite) νₐ 1327/1286, δ 806 cm⁻¹; NO₂ (neutral) νₐ 1610, νₛ 1325, δ 752 cm⁻¹; NO₂⁺ (nitronium) ν₃ 2360, ν₁ 1396 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-032** [DEFINITIVE] CS₂: ν₁ (Raman) 658, ν₂ (IR) 397, ν₃ (IR) 1533 cm⁻¹. COS: ν₁ 859, ν₂ 520, ν₃ 2062 cm⁻¹. CSe₂: ν₁ 369, ν₂ 313, ν₃ 1302 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-035** [DEFINITIVE] PF₃ (pyramidal C3v): ν₁ 893, ν₂ 487, ν₃ 858, ν₄ 346 cm⁻¹. PCl₃: ν₁ 515, ν₂ 258, ν₃ 504, ν₄ 186 cm⁻¹. Trend: ν₁ > ν₃ and ν₂ > ν₄ for halogeno compounds (opposite to hydrides) [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-041** [DEFINITIVE] ν(M-Cl) in octahedral MCl₆ⁿ⁻: general order ν₁ > ν₃, ν₄ > ν₅ > ν₆. Representative: SF₆ ν₁ 775, ν₃ 939 cm⁻¹; UF₆ ν₁ 667, ν₃ 628 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-042** [DEFINITIVE] PF₅ (trigonal-bipyramidal D3h): equatorial ν₅(E′) 944, axial ν₃(A₂″) 575, ν₁(A₁′) 817, ν₂(A₁′) 740 cm⁻¹. Equatorial > axial trend [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-046** [DEFINITIVE] CCl₄: ν₁ 460, ν₂ 214, ν₃ 792/765, ν₄ 314 cm⁻¹. CF₄: ν₁ 908, ν₂ 435, ν₃ 1283, ν₄ 631 cm⁻¹. CBr₄: ν₁ 267, ν₂ 123, ν₃ 672, ν₄ 183 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-062** [DEFINITIVE] Graphite: single Raman band at 1575 cm⁻¹ (E₂g). No IR bands (D6h symmetry). ν(RBM) of SWNT ~186 cm⁻¹ for d~1.4 nm, inversely proportional to diameter [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-069** [DEFINITIVE] H₂O₂: ν(OH) 3607/3608, ν(OO) 1394, δ(HOO) 864/1266, torsion 317 cm⁻¹. H₂O₂ nonplanar C2 with dihedral ~90° [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **ISO-001** [DEFINITIVE] Isotope shifts in diatomic molecules: ν(HX)/ν(DX) ≈ √2 ≈ 1.414 for hydrides/deuterides [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **SPC-009** [DEFINITIVE] Graphite Raman: single band at 1575 cm⁻¹ (E₂g). No IR bands (inactive due to D6h symmetry) [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GEO-016** [EXPERIMENTALLY_VERIFIED] Square-planar X₄²⁺ cations (D4h): 6 normal modes classified into A1g(R)+B1g(R)+B2g(R)+B2u(inactive)+Eu(IR). Characteristic frequency ranges for S₄²⁺, Se₄²⁺, Te₄²⁺ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-015** [EXPERIMENTALLY_VERIFIED] Fullerene C₆₀ characteristic modes: IR-active at 1428, 1182, 577, 527 cm⁻¹; Raman-active pentagonal pinching mode (A_g) at 1469 cm⁻¹, radial breathing (A_g) at 496 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-017** [EXPERIMENTALLY_VERIFIED] Polymeric nitrogen (cubic gauche): ν(N-N) single bond at 840 cm⁻¹ vs molecular N≡N triple bond at 2400 cm⁻¹ — dramatic ~1560 cm⁻¹ downshift indicates phase change [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-052** [EXPERIMENTALLY_VERIFIED] Si=Si double bond stretching: ~589 cm⁻¹ for trans-RClSi=SiClR. Si=C double bond: ~985 cm⁻¹. C≡P triple bond: ~1543-1565 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-071** [EXPERIMENTALLY_VERIFIED] Sc-N stretching in Sc₃N@C₈₀: νₐ(E′) 599, νₛ(A₁′) 411, δ(E′) 210 cm⁻¹ (Raman). νₐ ~597 cm⁻¹ (IR). On Sc→Y substitution: shifts to 707, 429, 194 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-083** [EXPERIMENTALLY_VERIFIED] N₅⁺ cation (pentanitrogen): V-shaped C2v with ν(N≡N) ~2237.6 cm⁻¹ (IR, N₂ matrix). Polymeric N₂ phase: Raman peak at 840 cm⁻¹ (cubic gauche, single N-N bonds) [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-084** [EXPERIMENTALLY_VERIFIED] Transuranium hexafluorides: NpF₆ ν₁ 654, ν₃ 624; PuF₆ ν₁ 656, ν₃ 616; ground and excited electronic state frequencies available. ²³⁵U/²³⁸UF₆ shift: 0.604 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **ISO-005** [EXPERIMENTALLY_VERIFIED] ²³⁵U/²³⁸U isotope shift in UF₆: only 0.604 cm⁻¹. High-resolution cold-jet technique required to resolve [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **SEL-010** [EXPERIMENTALLY_VERIFIED] Icosahedral C₆₀ (Ih): only 4 F₁u vibrations are IR-active; only 2 A_g and 8 H_g vibrations are Raman-active. Mutual exclusion rule holds [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **SUB-003** [EXPERIMENTALLY_VERIFIED] For SiFₙCl₄₋ₙ, SiClₙBr₄₋ₙ series: each stretching vibration appears at characteristic frequency determined by the specific M-X bond (e.g., SiF 910, SiCl 587, SiBr 486, SiI 333 cm⁻¹ in SiFClBrI) [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **VIB-005** [EXPERIMENTALLY_VERIFIED] Polymeric nitrogen (cubic gauche) at high pressure: ν(N-N) at 840 cm⁻¹ vs molecular N₂ at 2400 cm⁻¹ — dramatic shift indicates phase change from triple-bonded N₂ to single-bonded polymeric N [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GEO-014** [HIGH] Planar vs T-shaped XY₃: T-shaped (C2v) derived from trigonal-bipyramidal with 2 lone pairs. Three stretching modes expected vs one for planar D3h [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
- **GFQ-008** [HIGH] N≡N (triple bond) stretching: ~2300-2400 cm⁻¹ (N₂: 2359, N₂⁺: 2207 cm⁻¹); N=N (double): ~1550 cm⁻¹; N-N (single): ~1000 cm⁻¹ [source: nakamoto2008infrared]
